news.title: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
news.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Monday night that New Yorkers must resist the narrative that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public and put power back in their hands.

news.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
news.summary: If the deal goes through, it would be the latest in a long string of giant compute deals Anthropic has struck over the past year.

news.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
news.summary: The idea of embedded evaluators — in which supposedly "neutral" third-party observers are placed inside AI organizations — has been popularized over the last several months, as AI labs grapple with a rash of safety incidents that have spurred concerns over the potential harms of their technology.

news.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
news.summary: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.

news.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
news.summary: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

news.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
news.summary: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.

news.title: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
news.summary: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.

news.title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
news.summary: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.

news.title: DIY VR: How to build your own headset, and why you probably won't want to
